Description

Study spaces can be booked in the Virgil Building on Manvers Street in the City Centre

what3words: ///remit.hunt.open

  • You can book a study space for one or two hours.
  • Bookings can be made between 9:15am and 9:15pm.
  • You can book up to two hours per day for each category of space.
  • Bookings can be made up to 7 days in advance.

The Virgil Building is only accessible to current University of Bath students. Students are not permitted to bring guests into the building. Alumni may not use the Virgil Building.

You must scan your library card to enter the building at all times. If you are having trouble entering the building, please report to the reception desk.

Many more study spaces are available with no booking required. Go to go.bath.ac.uk/study-spaces for details.
